CUSTOMER_FLEET.expr: pick({'Nordics': ['Nordfrakt Logistik', 'Fjordline Transport', 'Baltic Kyl AB', 'Vasa Kollektiv'], 'DACH': ['Rheinland Spedition', 'Alpen Logistik', 'Hanse Cargo'], 'Benelux & France': ['Delta Maas Transport', 'Lumiere Fret', 'Scheldt Logistics'], 'Central & Eastern Europe': ['Vistula Haulage', 'Morava Trans', 'Danube Freight'], 'UK & Ireland': ['Pennine Haulage', 'Clyde Distribution', 'Liffey Logistics']}[actor['REGION']])

_MODEL.expr: pick({'Long Haulage': ['R 450', 'R 500', 'S 500', 'S 540', 'S 660 V8'], 'Regional Distribution': ['G 410', 'R 410', 'P 320'], 'Urban Distribution': ['P 280', 'L 280', 'P 320'], 'Construction': ['G 450 XT', 'P 410 XT'], 'City Bus': ['Citywide LF'], 'Coach': ['Touring HD', 'Interlink HD']}[actor['APPLICATION']])

_PT0.expr: weighted({'Diesel': 70, 'HVO100': 21, 'Biogas': 9 if actor['APPLICATION'] in ('City Bus', 'Urban Distribution', 'Regional Distribution') else 0})

_SW.expr: int(uniform(30, 380)) if (actor['REGION'] == 'Nordics' and ((actor['APPLICATION'] in ('Urban Distribution', 'Regional Distribution', 'City Bus') and chance(0.8)) or (actor['APPLICATION'] == 'Long Haulage' and chance(0.4)))) else (int(uniform(20, 300)) if (actor['APPLICATION'] in ('Urban Distribution', 'City Bus') and chance(0.12)) else 0)

_OVD.expr: int(uniform(3, 42)) if chance(0.11 if actor['MAINTENANCE_PLAN'] == 'Flexible' else 0.2) else 0

columns.name: POWERTRAIN
columns.expr: 'Battery Electric' if (actor['_SW'] > 0 and (as_of - d).days < actor['_SW']) else actor['_PT0']

columns.name: VEHICLE_MODEL
columns.expr: ({'Urban Distribution': '25 P BEV', 'Regional Distribution': '40 R BEV', 'City Bus': 'Citywide BEV'}.get(actor['APPLICATION'], '40 R BEV')) if r['POWERTRAIN'] == 'Battery Electric' else actor['_MODEL']

columns.name: CAB_SERIES
columns.expr: 'Bus & Coach' if actor['APPLICATION'] in ('City Bus', 'Coach') else r['VEHICLE_MODEL'].replace('25 ', '').replace('40 ', '')[0] + '-series'

columns.name: DISTANCE_KM
columns.expr: lognorm({'Long Haulage': 640, 'Regional Distribution': 290, 'Urban Distribution': 170, 'Construction': 160, 'City Bus': 215, 'Coach': 470}[actor['APPLICATION']], 0.22) * (0.8 if r['POWERTRAIN'] == 'Battery Electric' else 1)

columns.name: _IDLE
columns.expr: min(0.45, {'Long Haulage': 0.075, 'Regional Distribution': 0.11, 'Urban Distribution': 0.14, 'Construction': 0.22, 'City Bus': 0.13, 'Coach': 0.085}[actor['APPLICATION']] * actor['_EFF'] * uniform(0.75, 1.25) * (0.6 if r['POWERTRAIN'] == 'Battery Electric' else 1) * (1.15 if r['_WINTER'] else 1) + (0.17 * ramp(180) if actor['_STORY1'] else 0))

columns.name: FUEL_L
columns.expr: 0.0 if r['POWERTRAIN'] == 'Battery Electric' else (r['DISTANCE_KM'] * {'Long Haulage': 29.5, 'Regional Distribution': 25.5, 'Urban Distribution': 23.5, 'Construction': 39.0, 'City Bus': 36.0, 'Coach': 26.5}[actor['APPLICATION']] / 100.0 * uniform(0.94, 1.06) * (1.04 if r['_WINTER'] else 1) * (1.77 - actor['_SKILL'] / 100.0) * (1 + (0.08 * ramp(180) if actor['_STORY1'] else 0)) + r['IDLE_HOURS'] * 2.9)

columns.name: ENERGY_KWH
columns.expr: r['DISTANCE_KM'] * {'Urban Distribution': 1.05, 'Regional Distribution': 1.24, 'City Bus': 1.12}.get(actor['APPLICATION'], 1.2) * uniform(0.92, 1.08) * ((1.22 if r['REGION'] == 'Nordics' else 1.1) if r['_WINTER'] else 1) if r['POWERTRAIN'] == 'Battery Electric' else 0.0

columns.name: PAYLOAD_TONNES
columns.expr: 0.0 if actor['APPLICATION'] in ('City Bus', 'Coach') else {'Long Haulage': 21, 'Regional Distribution': 13, 'Urban Distribution': 7, 'Construction': 24}[actor['APPLICATION']] * uniform(0.55, 1.25)

columns.name: DRIVER_GRADE
columns.expr: 'A' if r['DRIVER_SCORE'] >= 88 else 'B' if r['DRIVER_SCORE'] >= 80 else 'C' if r['DRIVER_SCORE'] >= 70 else 'D' if r['DRIVER_SCORE'] >= 60 else 'E'

columns.name: DAYS_OVERDUE
columns.expr: max(0, actor['_OVD'] - r['_DAYSAGO']) if actor['_OVD'] > 0 else 0

columns.name: SERVICE_STATUS
columns.expr: 'Overdue' if r['DAYS_OVERDUE'] > 0 else ('Due soon' if (actor['_INT'] - (d.toordinal() + actor['_OFF']) % actor['_INT']) <= 10 else 'On plan')

columns.name: SERVICE_ON_TIME
columns.expr: (1 if chance(0.95 if actor['MAINTENANCE_PLAN'] == 'Flexible' else 0.84) else 0) if r['SERVICE_DUE'] else 0

columns.name: UNPLANNED_STOPS
columns.expr: 1 if chance(r['DISTANCE_KM'] * (0.000032 if actor['MAINTENANCE_PLAN'] == 'Flexible' else 0.00006) * (2.2 if r['DAYS_OVERDUE'] > 0 else 1)) else 0
